reason: Money is tight since daycare went up, and we do library storytime, parks and church group for free. I'd maybe use the free first visit, but $13 a kid every time doesn't fit my budget.
objection: We'd go once or twice a month at most, so the unlimited plan isn't worth it, and $13 a visit adds up fast when the park and library cost nothing.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in around $6 to $8 per kid on weekdays, or a free or half-price day each week.
